currentOriginalJSONStream.scope: Complete original native cell and performance/resource JSON bytes. Producer byte-roundtrip and complete-tail checks passed; independent package relocation is recorded separately.

runtime.cpuModel: AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 8840U w/ Radeon 780M Graphics

fixturePlan.supersededUncollectedPlan: fixtures-review01.json and planned-matrix-review01.json bind the intermediate b71 candidate before the real help-focus correction; they have zero collected samples and remain historical,not overwritten.

originalReports.pathQualification: Current JSON logical reports resolve through review/evidence/review01/REPORT-LOCATIONS.json. Original raw gzip states retain their physical report-relative raw/ paths and exact encoded/decoded bindings. No report is relabelled or normalized.

phone.order: Alternating paired serial arms; fresh context per arm/cell/sample, one shared browser. No slow observations removed.
phone.latency: Host monotonic action-to-usable-result time including Playwright round trips and two animation frames. No CDP or execution wrappers in compare.
phone.cache: Empty context storage/cache, not cold OS caches. Equal strict request routing disables HTTP cache.
phone.startup: Actual source/emitted/file navigation, held player and picker, correct default lesson/cursor, visible working search/navigation/current content after layout. Index setup occurs after startup.
phone.playingFilter: Same trusted playing-filter action in both views. Compact intentionally pauses on search focus; Full preserves legacy playing behavior. Endpoints enforce that explicit presentation policy.
phone.stateEvidence: Full before/after states are asserted before packing, then retained losslessly as checksum-bound gzip JSON outside every timed interval. Readable summaries replace repeated source snapshots/queues with their exact hashes and source-row identities; no raw protocol field is dropped.
phone.variation: Range/median > 25% AND range > corresponding absolute threshold on either arm. Descriptive, not statistical significance.

newActions.large: Predeclared large-history/payload fixtures reported separately; no invented baseline.

phone.resource: Separate instrumented session; retained playing-switch warmup roundtrip, then 20 complete paused Compact-Full-Compact cycles from stable same-surface baseline; weak-reference counters, CDP DOM/heap, GC where supported. Not a blanket no-leak proof.
phone.disposition: Every flag retains data with disposition.status=open. Collection never infers a waiver or owner acceptance.

environment.timing: Uninstrumented compare ran to completion before the separate resource collector and before complete CI. Functional native jobs were already finished. Light documentation/provenance data work is not a host-idle or OS-isolation claim.

methodQualification.fieldEndpoints: Both new ordinary endpoints were frozen before sampling. fields-open starts with the Fields/attributes disclosure closed and ends with its visible nonempty bounded index. field-definition-open ends with the meaningful inline definition region focused and in viewport. The same unchanged paused canonical queue/cursor is asserted; smaller DOM alone is not proof. No historical action baseline exists for these new endpoints.
methodQualification.interpretation: Exit2 means complete-with-open-review-flags,not collection failure and not performance acceptance. All samples/warmups/outliers are kept. Material,variability and ordinary target decisions are independent. 249.865ms Compact-emitted switch median is below250; no rounding-induced miss.
methodQualification.profiles: No current profiles were collected. Earlier45-context b91 whole-session profiles remain historical diagnostics and cannot provide current isolated causal action latency.
methodQualification.resources: Three separately instrumented paths with20paused same-surface roundtrips each; all four declared zero-growth bounds met. Instrumented heap growth is reported,not ignored; weak-reference counter bookkeeping is part of the heap. No blanket run-time no-leak claim.
